## Goal
- Complete the "FINAL IVX IA REAL SENIOR DEVELOPER RECOVERY" mandate: 200-root forensic audit of chat module, fix the real root cause of chat opening on months-old conversations + slow load, test, commit, deploy, build APK, verify live — NO narrative planning, NO fake "no code change required"

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_SENSITIVE_OPERATION, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications, no "no code change required" when a fix is required
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — must use Install tool
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — large files >~30KB MUST use gzip-base64; Python `gzip.compress(raw, 9)` ; omit `contentEncoding` for small files
- Render deploy API: same action endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; length ~1620; refreshToken at `/tmp/owner_rt`)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- `/tmp/` files get wiped by sandbox resets — recreate via heredoc each time; use project-local paths like `backend/scripts/` for persistent scripts
- Watchman refuses to start in low-priority sandbox (nice_value=19) — must exclude from PATH via `/tmp/nowatch` dir with shim script that exits 1
- `bun test backend/` = 1521 tests across 111 files (~2.7s); `bun x tsc --noEmit` in expo/ for full typecheck (takes ~60s, run with nohup in background)
- Gradle builds exceed 60s tool timeout — must run with `nohup env PATH=/tmp/nowatch:$PATH ./gradlew assembleRelease --build-cache --stacktrace > /tmp/gradle-build.log 2>&1 &` then poll PID + log tail + APK mtime/size
- APK presign upload API: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` returns `uploadUrl` (900s expiry); PUT raw bytes with `Content-Type: application/vnd.android.package-archive`; S3 ETag matches local md5 when successful
- `buildOwnerAIResponsePayloadInner` constructs response by explicitly listing each field from `internalMetadata` — MUST add new fields to this explicit list or they will be constructed but silently dropped (caused `executionStatus: ABSENT` bug)

## Progress
### Done
- **APK v1.4.10(42) through v1.4.14(46) — ALL BUILT + UPLOADED + LIVE-VERIFIED** (see prior history; latest was v1.4.14(46) md5 `f20d73733f32a1a430b26a0e37a3d841`)

- **FINAL IVX IA CHAT EXECUTION MODE — IMPLEMENTED + TESTED + COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + APK v1.4.14(46)**: 11 files, 26 backend tests, execution-mode classifier (10 categories), 9-field status payload, live-polling hook, execution console bubble UI, forbidden narrative phrase guard. GitHub HEAD `f374b2bf`. APK live. (See prior summary for full detail.)

- **FINAL IVX IA REAL SENIOR DEVELOPER RECOVERY — CHAT BOUNDED-LOAD FIX 2026-07-19 — IMPLEMENTED + TESTED + COMMITTED + APK v1.4.15(47) BUILT + UPLOADED + LIVE-VERIFIED**:
  - **Root cause proven from code**: `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatService.ts:1186` — `listOwnerMessages` ran `.order('created_at', { ascending: true })` with **NO LIMIT**. On a months-old conversation with hundreds of turns, the FlatList had to lay out every message before scroll-to-latest could work. The previous "OPEN-ON-LATEST FIX" (v1.4.13/45) patched the scroll retry (8 attempts × 180ms ≈ 1.5s) but did NOT bound the load — the retry gave up while the FlatList was still measuring hundreds of old messages, leaving the viewport at months-old messages.
  - **Fix (2 surgical changes in `ivxChatService.ts`)**:
    1. Bounded DB query: `.order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(120)` — fetch newest 120 first, then `[...rawRows].reverse()` for chronological display. INITIAL_PAGE_LIMIT = 120.
    2. Display cap: merged result capped to newest 160 (DISPLAY_WINDOW = 160) so the 400-row local mirror cannot re-introduce the slow-layout bug. Full mirror still persisted for durability via `persistOwnerMessageMirror`.
  - **2 pre-existing tsc errors fixed** (from prior EXECUTION MODE work):
    - `useExecutionStatusPoll.ts:84` — `typecheckRaw` was `unknown`; fixed by narrowing via `isRecord(typecheckField)` guard
    - `expo/shared/ivx/types.ts` — `IVXOwnerAICanonicalResponse` was missing `executionStatus?` field; added it
  - **New test file**: `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatOpenOnLatestFix.test.ts` — 9 tests, 300 expect() calls, all pass. Tests prove: 400-msg thread caps to newest 160 in chronological order, latest turn is LAST element, months-old conversation no longer surfaces January messages, merge of 120 newest remote + 400 local mirror caps correctly, equal-timestamp stable order, empty/single-message edge cases
  - **Version bump**: v1.4.15(47), buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_19_BUILD_47_CHAT_OPEN_ON_LATEST_BOUNDED_LOAD`
  - **QA**: `bun x tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `bun test backend/` 1521 pass / 0 fail; targeted tests 9/9 pass
  - **6 files committed** via owner-gated GitHub API (6/6 OK, 0 FAIL) → GitHub HEAD `d7d7fa018afa90dfbfac57aab3241ca0d22f24fc`
  - **APK v1.4.15(47) BUILT + UPLOADED + LIVE-VERIFIED**: 84,550,192 bytes, md5 `2c8b23c9b700490584f56d099b734dc7`, sha256 `72f68bf9c4fba64658c6f294c47cd32304eca0cead0e9a99c55c5e6adc1e7229`, live at https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.15.apk HTTP 200, content-length 84550192, S3 ETag `"2c8b23c9b700490584f56d099b734dc7"` == local md5 ✓

### In Progress
- **3-way SHA parity NOT yet achieved**: GitHub HEAD is `d7d7fa01` but runtime /health shows `1d6f75d4` (boot 17:10:31Z — an intermediate commit from this session auto-deployed by Render). Multiple Render deploy re-triggers returned `build_in_progress` (deploy IDs `dep-d9egavrtqb8s73afllqg`, `dep-d9egfi741pts73et5t3g`) but runtime commit never updated to `d7d7fa01`. The fix is **frontend-only** (Expo client) so the APK IS the deploy artifact — the backend runtime commit mismatch is for a tsc-only type fix that doesn't change runtime behavior.

### Blocked
- Render deploy for final HEAD `d7d7fa01` may be stuck or queued behind the intermediate auto-deploy; needs another deploy trigger or manual Render dashboard check

## Key Decisions
- Bounded the DB query to newest 120 (descending then reversed) instead of fetching ALL messages ascending — the root cause was unbounded layout, not scroll logic; the previous scroll-retry fix was correct but insufficient on its own
- Display cap of 160 chosen so the latest turn + recent context fit in ~2 screens and scroll-to-latest completes in <200ms; full 400-row mirror still persisted for durability
- The fix is frontend-only (Expo client) — the APK IS the production deploy artifact for this change; backend runtime commit parity is secondary since no backend code changed
- Fixed 2 pre-existing tsc errors from prior EXECUTION MODE work rather than leaving them — a clean typecheck is required for an honest VERIFIED claim
- Honest about 3-way parity: will NOT claim VERIFIED for SHA parity since runtime shows `1d6f75d4` not `d7d7fa01`; the APK verification IS verified (S3 ETag == local md5)
- `buildOwnerAIResponsePayloadInner` constructs response by explicitly listing each field — new fields MUST be added to this list or they silently drop
- expo/package.json remains at 1.4.8 because the system blocks direct `package.json` edits; version bumped in `app.config.ts` and `android/app/build.gradle` instead

## Next Steps
- Re-trigger Render deploy for `d7d7fa01` or verify via Render dashboard that the build completed; achieve 3-way SHA parity
- Update plan_md `.rork/plans/stop-kotlin-work-expo-app-is-the-only-mo_1784341475573.plan.md` with the completion entry for this fix
- Deliver honest FINAL EVIDENCE to owner in the required format (200-root audit template)

- Root cause file+line: `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatService.ts:1186` (was `.order('created_at', { ascending: true })` with no `.limit()`)
- Worker limitation acknowledged: the production worker (`backend/worker.ts`) cannot do file-level code changes — it has no repo/git/editor access. The senior developer (this agent) does the real work directly.
- `IVXOwnerAICanonicalResponse` in `expo/shared/ivx/types.ts` now includes `executionStatus?: IVXExecutionStatusPayload`
- `useExecutionStatusPoll.ts` typecheck narrowing: `const typecheckField = evidenceRaw?.typecheck; const typecheckRaw = isRecord(typecheckField) ? typecheckField : {};`
